data: Lassés d’être les souffre-douleurs de leur communauté, Ajar le serpent et son pote Pitt le scorpion décident de tenter leur chance dans l'oasis voisine où vit la haute bourgeoisie du désert saharien et d'y retrouver Eva, une belle serpente dont Ajar est tombé fou amoureux. C’est le début de folles aventures qui les amèneront à traverser le désert à la poursuite de l’amour et plus encore à la découverte d’eux-mêmes… (Two different tribes of snakes live in the desert. One kind are beautiful and lives in a peaceful waterhole where they are protected and venerated by humans. The other one are poisonous and try to survive in the dust, sand and heat where they are hunted and killed by Tuaregs. From the beginning of time, these two tribes hate each other. SAHARA is the story of Ajar, a young poisonous snake who is the laughing stock of his own kind because he hasn’t shed his skin yet and Eva, young princess who wants to escape the waterhole to avoid a forced marriage. These two are going to meet and fall in love. Unfortunately Eva will be kidnapped by Tuaregs. Ajar and his best friend Pitt the scorpion will cross the ruthless Sahara to save Eva from a terrible fate.)

Lassés d’être les souffre-douleurs de leur communauté, Ajar le serpent et son pote Pitt le scorpion décident de tenter leur chance dans l'oasis voisine où vit la haute bourgeoisie du désert saharien et d'y retrouver Eva, une belle serpente dont Ajar est tombé fou amoureux. C’est le début de folles aventures qui les amèneront à traverser le désert à la poursuite de l’amour et plus encore à la découverte d’eux-mêmes…

Two different tribes of snakes live in the desert. One kind are beautiful and lives in a peaceful waterhole where they are protected and venerated by humans. The other one are poisonous and try to survive in the dust, sand and heat where they are hunted and killed by Tuaregs. From the beginning of time, these two tribes hate each other. SAHARA is the story of Ajar, a young poisonous snake who is the laughing stock of his own kind because he hasn’t shed his skin yet and Eva, young princess who wants to escape the waterhole to avoid a forced marriage. These two are going to meet and fall in love. Unfortunately Eva will be kidnapped by Tuaregs. Ajar and his best friend Pitt the scorpion will cross the ruthless Sahara to save Eva from a terrible fate.
